summary: Expand Mochi’s rewards into a 100-cat collection: Mochi plus 99 collectible friends, with only three visitors rendered at once. Existing milestone unlocks are preserved. Cat Points combine validated learning milestones with a bounded +2 bonus when a scheduled subject reaches exactly 2× its planned foreground study time; normal study still stops at 1×, optional bonus timing stops at 2×, and no extra time reward exists beyond that.
